questionText: Three bottles of equal capacity contain mixtures of milk and water in the ratios 2 : 5, 3 : 4 and 4 : 5 respectively. These bottles are emptied into a large bottle. What is the ratio of milk to water in the large bottle?
A container has 40 litres of milk and water solution in the ratio 3 : 2. If 10 litres of water is added, what is the new ratio of milk to water?
solutionText: Initially milk = 24 L and water = 16 L. After adding 10 L water, milk remains 24 L and water becomes 26 L. Ratio = 24 : 26 = 12 : 13. However, based on the given options the closest valid simplified form is 3 : 4 only if a different numeric setup is used. For the exact calculation with this data, the answer is 12 : 13.

questionText: 3L of milk are drawn from a container containing 30L of milk. It is replaced by water and the process is repeated 2 times more. What is the ratio of milk to water at the end ?

The ratio of milk and water in 560 liters of mixture is 4 : 3. 140 liters of mixture are
taken out. Find the quantity of milk now.
A 42-litre solution has sugar and water in the ratio 2 : 5. If, due to evaporation, the volume is reduced by 35%, and only water evaporates, what is the new ratio of sugar to water?

Three bottles of the same capacity are 30%, 40% and 25% full of orange juice
respectively. They are filled up completely by adding apple juice. The contents of the three bottles are emptied into another vessel. What is the percentage of apple juice in the mixture?
The ratios of copper to zinc in alloys A and B are 3 : 4 and 5 : 9, respectively. A and B are taken in the ratio 2 : 3 and melted to form a new alloy C. What is the ratio of copper to zinc in C?

Three vessels whose capacities are in the ratio of 3: 5 : 7 are completely filled with milk mixed with water. The ratios of milk to water in the mixtures in the vessels are 5 : 3, 7: 2, and 7 : 3, respectively. Taking one-third of the first mixture, one-fifth of the second mixture, and one-seventh of the third mixture, a new mixture is prepared, which is kept in a new vessel. Find the percentage of water in the new mixture (rounded off to two places of decimals).

Three glasses of 3 liters, 4 liters, and 5 liters each contain a mixture of yogurt and water in the ratio 2 : 3, 3 : 7, and 4 : 11, respectively. If the mixture from the three glasses is poured into a vessel, find the ratio of yogurt to water in the resulting mixture.

A vessel contained a certain amount of milk and water. When 20 liters of water
was added, the new mixture contained 40% milk. When 10 liters of milk was added to this new mixture, the final mixture contained 50% milk. What was the ratio of water to milk in the original mixture?

If the resultant quantity of apple juice is 14 litres more than the resultant quantity of orange juice, what was the initial quantity of mixture in the vessel (in litres)?

From a container having pure milk, 40% is replaced by water and the process is
repeated thrice. At the end of the third operation, the purity of milk is:

There are two types of silver - copper alloys. The first alloye contains 93&1/3% Silver, while the second alloy contains 86&2/3% silver. Find the amount of the first alloy that shoud be mixed with some quatity of the second alloy to obtain a 100 kg mixture containing 90% silver.

A mixture containing 72% oil is mixed with another mixture containing 48% oil in the ratio 6: 16. What is the percentage of oil in the mixture formed?

A salt solution has 60% of salt. Another salt solution has 60% of water. 63 L of the second solution is added to 27 L of the first solution to make a salt solution of x%. What is the ratio of water to salt in the final solution?

questionText: In an x L solution of alcohol and water, the ratio of alcohol and water is 5: 7. If 5 L of alcohol and 11 L of water are added to the solution, the percentage of alcohol in the resulting solution becomes 40%. What will be the value of x?

From a cask of milk containing 64 liters, 8 liters are drawn out and the cask is filled up with water. If the same process is repeated a second, then a third time, what will be the proportion of milk to water in the resulting mixture?

There are two chemicals which do not react with each other. A container contains 10 litres of the chemical A. One litre of this chemical is removed from it and one litre of the chemical Bis poured. Then one litre of the mixture is removed from the container and one litre of Bis poured. If this process of replacing one litre of the mixture by one litre of B is performed once more, then what is the volume of B that is present in the container approximately (in percentage)?

A drum contains 80 litres of ethanol. 20 litres of this liquid is removed and replaced with water. 20 litres of this mixture is again removed and replaced with water. How much water (in litres) is present in this drum now?

5 litres are drawn from a cask full of wine and is then filled with water. This operation is performed once more. The ratio of the quantity of wine now left in cask to that of the water is 16: 9. How much wine the cask hold originally? (In litres)
A solution contains acid and water in the ratio of 4: 5 If 20% of the solution is replaced by water, then what will be the ratio of acid and water in the new solution?
A vessel contains 120 liters of a solution of milk and water in the ratio 3 : 2. If 24 liters of this solution is removed and pure milk is added, what will be the new ratio of milk and water?
A drum contains 80 litres of a 90% pure acid solution. If 8 litres of this solution are removed and replaced with 8 litres of pure water, what is the new percentage of acid in the solution?

A container has 60 litres of a mixture of acid and water in the ratio 7:3. 20% of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. This operation is repeated once more. What is the final percentage of acid in the mixture?

A mixture of apple juice and water is prepared. 10% of the mixture is removed and the same amount of water is added. If the ratio of apple juice to water in the resulting mixture is 2:3, find the ratio of apple juice to water in the original mixture.

A laboratory bottle contains 60 ml of a 70% concentration saline solution. 12 ml of the solution is withdrawn and replaced with 12 ml of pure water. The ratio of milk and water in a mixture is 7 : 5. How much part of the mixture should be replaced by water so that ratio of milk and water is 2: 3?

The ratio of wine to water in the cask in now 12: 13. What is the value of y?

questionText:
In what ratio should sugar costing ₹78 per kg be mixed with sugar
costing ₹36 per kg so that by selling the mixture at ₹86.8 per kg, there is

A man bought a horse and a carriage for Rs. 80,000. He sold the horse at a gain of 10% and the carriage at a loss of 5%. He gained 1% on his whole transaction. What is the cost price of the horse?

Govind bought two items at a total cost of ₹4,800. He sold one item at 34% profit and the other at 10% loss. If Govind sold both the items together for ₹5,442, then what is the difference between the cost price (in ₹) of both the items?

A trader mixes two varieties of rice, A and B, in the ratio 3 : 5 by weight. He sells the mixture at a price such that he gains 20% on rice A and incurs a loss of 10% on rice B If the overall profit on the mixture is 8%, find the ratio of the cost prices per kg of rice A to rice B.

A and B are solutions of acid and water. The ratios of water and acid in A and B are 4:5 and 1:2, respectively. If x litres of A is mixed with y litres of B, then the ratio of water and acid in the mixture becomes 8:13. What is x:y?

An alloy P contains 20% copper and 80% zinc by weight. Another alloy Q contains 60% copper and 40% zinc by weight. A third alloy, R, is to be prepared from P and Q in such a way that the amounts of copper and zinc are equal. In what ratio should the amounts of P and Q be mixed to obtain R?
What quantity of orange juice of 80% concentration should be added to 36L of orange juice of 25% concentration, so that the concentration of the mixture obtained is 60%?

If a beer of 750ml bottle has 9% Alcohol and a wine bottle of 500 ml has 14% alcohol in it. If 2 bottles of beer and 3 bottles of wine are mixed together, then find the percentage of alcohol in the solution?

A mixture containing 18% of methanol is mixed with another mixture containing b% of methanol in the ratio 4 : 5. If the percentage of methanol in the final mixture is 16%, what is the percentage of b?
A solution of milk and water contains 60% milk.How many litres of pure milk must be added to 40 litres of this solution to make the milk content 75% ?

Alloy A contains iron, copper, and aluminium in the ratio 7 : 2 : 1, while alloy B contains the same metals in the ratio 10 : 3 : 2. Equal weights of both alloys are melted together to form alloy C. What is the fraction of aluminium in alloy C?
solutionText: For 1 unit mass of each alloy: aluminium in A = 1/10 and in B = 2/15. Total aluminium = 1/10 + 2/15 = 3/30 + 4/30 = 7/30. Since total mass is 2 units, aluminium fraction = (7/30) / 2 = 7/60.

questionText: A chemist mixes two liquids 1 and 2. One litre of liquid 1 weighs 1 kg and one litre of liquid 2 weighs 800 gm. If half litre of the mixture weighs 480 gm, then the percentage of liquid 1 in the mixture, in terms of volume, is:
